Post the source journal and retain its actual receipt/payment evidence.
steps: Open Books & Reconciliation and select Cash flow classification. Expand Cash entry period (Asia/Manila), enter From and Through, then select Apply period.
Review the designated cash/bank accounts. To change the scope, use Choose cash/bank designation account, select the account and expand Cash/bank account designation.

Set Include this account in cash-flow reports to Include as cash/bank or Exclude from cash/bank, as approved, and select Save designation. An archived account cannot be newly included as an active cash/bank target.
In Posted cash movements, review the journal, date, signed amount, Classified/Unclassified status and version. Use Previous entries or Next entries to find the required page.
Use Choose posted cash entry to select an entry on the current page. Expand Classify selected cash entry. Positive amounts are receipts; negative amounts are payments.

Choose Cash-flow category: operating, investing, financing or Internal transfer. For a movement covering several approved categories, choose Split across categories and enter exact signed amounts that sum to the selected entry amount.

Enter a specific Classification reason, then select Save classification version. Check the updated status and version. To correct a classification, select the entry again and save a reviewed new version.

For an internal transfer, classify the corresponding cash entries in the same journal and verify their transfer amounts net to zero. Continue to Financial statements > Cash Flow to review remaining exceptions.
chapters.result: Cash/bank designations and signed cash-flow classifications are retained as audited versions, with the posted journal unchanged.
notes: Existing cash entries begin Unclassified. Do not choose a category merely to remove a warning; use the underlying financial evidence.
Saving a correction appends a version. Earlier classifications and original journals are retained; this action does not change the bank balance or execute a payment.

The report uses the current cash-designation set for its chosen period. Changing that set changes opening/closing cash scope, not journal history. Previous BANK_CASH posting-role designations remain until explicitly changed.
Bank reconciliation and cash-flow classification serve different purposes: matching a bank statement does not classify its movements automatically.

connections.Comes from: Posted cash/bank journal entries and Finance's classification evidence
connections.Next module: Complete Cash Flow review, exception resolution and retained classification history

screenshots.caption: Choose the approved asset account and save whether it belongs in cash/bank reporting.
Classify a posted signed cash entry, explain the reason and save a new audited version.

chapters.title: 41. Review Cash Flow and resolve classification exceptions
chapters.module: Books & Reconciliation / Financial statements / Cash Flow
chapters.roles: Authorized Books reader; Books writer for classification corrections
chapters.purpose: Explain the change from opening to closing cash while keeping incomplete or unmatched classifications visible.
before: Review the designated cash/bank account scope and classify posted movements using their actual evidence.
Choose the same reporting period used for the cash review.
steps: Open Books & Reconciliation > Financial statements, apply From and Through under Report period (Asia/Manila), then choose Cash Flow under Financial report.
Review operating, investing and financing amounts, opening/closing cash, unclassified movements and any transfer-exception amounts. Read the report basis and notes.

If Cash-flow classification is incomplete appears, check whether no cash/bank accounts are designated, entries remain Unclassified or transfer journals are unmatched. A zero-net exception can still require review; do not rely only on a total of zero.

Review Unmatched transfer journals and their references. Return to Cash flow classification to classify the correct entries or append a reviewed correction. Both transfer sides must reconcile in the same journal.
Return to Financial statements and refresh or apply the period again after the changes. Recheck completeness and the opening-to-closing cash reconciliation.

Select Export complete report. Retain the Report, Scope and totals, and Transfer exceptions sheets when present. Mark an incomplete export as unresolved review evidence rather than a final classified statement.
chapters.result: The cash movement is reconciled and any remaining classification exceptions are explicit and traceable.
notes: Unclassified entries and unmatched transfers make Cash Flow incomplete, even when positive and negative exceptions cancel in total.
An incomplete report can still reconcile opening and closing cash through its displayed exception buckets. That does not mean the categories are ready for final signoff.
Cash-flow categories do not change the posted journal, tax treatment, inventory quantity or bank statement matching.

connections.Comes from: Cash/bank designation, posted cash entries and saved classification versions
connections.Next module: Finance signoff, retained complete report export and further classification review if incomplete

screenshots.caption: Review cash-flow totals, completeness and unmatched-transfer details before exporting the complete report.

chapters.title: 42. Reconcile stock references with Books Inventory
chapters.roles: User with both Books and Finance read access; Auditor where permitted
chapters.purpose: Investigate the difference between current physical stock references and posted Inventory controls without automatically changing either source.
before: Confirm the company. Review receipts, warehouse placements, dispatches, bills, landed costs and opening balances.
Ask the administrator to grant the appropriate Books and Finance read permissions if the tab is unavailable.
steps: Open Books & Reconciliation and select Inventory reconciliation. Select Refresh snapshot to load the current comparison.
Read Current physical snapshot, Ledger through date, Asia/Manila basis and the listed Inventory controls before comparing figures.
Review Office reference value, Warehouse reference value, Combined known reference value, Posted Inventory ledger and Reference vs ledger difference.
Search the reconciliation rows by SKU or product. Compare office/warehouse quantities, unit cost, cost basis, reference values and Issue details against the source records.
If Finance review needed appears, investigate missing/invalid costs, zero costs, orphan products or negative balances. Unknown values are excluded; Unavailable is not a zero difference.
Trace the difference through receipt/bill timing, opening balances, cost references and Inventory postings. Review the source records; do not change stock merely to make this report match.
Select Export reconciliation. Keep Stock references and Scope and totals. After source review, use Accounts & journals for any Finance-authorized correction, then refresh.
chapters.result: Finance and warehouse staff can identify evidenced differences and retain a current stock-to-ledger reconciliation for review.
notes: Values use current landed/manual references, not historical stock valuation or a new FIFO/weighted-average method.
Office and warehouse are separate pools. The displayed standard, current and historical Inventory controls retain older posted balances.
Timing, opening balances, missing capitalization or changed costs can cause differences. This report never changes quantities or posts corrections.

connections.Comes from: Master Inventory office balances, warehouse quantities, approved cost references and posted Inventory journals
connections.Next module: Source investigation, Finance-authorized correction when needed and retained reconciliation export

screenshots.caption: Compare separate office/warehouse reference values with posted Inventory and investigate exception rows.

chapters.title: 43. Import and reconcile the bank statement
chapters.purpose: Match bank statement transactions to the posted accounting entries and verify the closing balance.
before: Post the confirmed bank payments/receipts and prepare the actual statement period.
Prepare CSV/Excel columns Date, Reference, Description and Amount; use YYYY-MM-DD dates, positive deposits and negative withdrawals.
steps: Choose Bank reconciliation and expand Import bank statement and start reconciliation.
Select Bank ledger account, Statement date, Opening balance (PHP) and Closing balance (PHP).
Choose Statement CSV / Excel file. Review the imported transaction preview and correct dates, references, descriptions or signed amounts before saving. Use Add transaction or Remove row when needed.
Save the reconciliation. Open its statement lines and load the available posted bank entries.
For each statement line, choose the exact signed Matching ledger transaction and select Match entry. Investigate missing or different entries before proceeding.
Complete reconciliation only when every line is matched and the closing ledger balance reconciles to the statement.
chapters.result: The completed reconciliation links the statement evidence to the posted ledger entries.
notes: Supported statement uploads contain 1–1,000 transaction rows. Amounts use a sign and up to two decimal places.
Do not invent a payment to force a match. First investigate source postings, dates, bank charges and account selection, then record an approved correction if needed.

connections.Comes from: Confirmed payment/receipt journals and actual bank statement
connections.Next module: Completed financial review and audit evidence

screenshots.caption: Preview statement transactions, match posted bank entries and reconcile the closing balance.

chapters.title: 44. Review the audit history
chapters.purpose: Trace who performed a controlled action, in which company and against which record.
before: Identify the transaction number, record or time period being investigated.
steps: Open Books & Reconciliation and select Audit log.
Load the available audit records using the tab's load/refresh action.
Review the actor, action, record type, reference and timestamp for the relevant activity.
Inspect the recorded details and compare the event with its source document, journal, service visit or account action.
Retain the relevant references in the company's review notes and escalate an unexplained action to the administrator or Finance lead.
chapters.result: The reviewer can trace the action to its actor and saved business record.
notes: Audit history is append-only. Deleting, archiving or restoring a ledger account does not delete its audit events.
Posted accounting history also remains protected; a correcting action produces further traceable history.

connections.Comes from: Controlled financial, account and service actions
connections.Next module: Investigation, correction approval or management review

screenshots.caption: Audit events preserve the actor, action and record context.

chapters.title: 45. Register delivered devices and schedule service
chapters.purpose: Track delivered serials, warranty dates and planned maintenance or repairs after sale.
before: Use serial-controlled stock and complete dispatch plus confirmed POD for the specific serial.
steps: Open Medical Device Service. In Delivered medical devices & warranties, expand Register delivered serial number.
Choose the Verified delivered serial. Enter Warranty expires where applicable and Preventive maintenance interval (months), then save.
Confirm the asset's customer, product, serial, warranty and next-maintenance date.
In Preventive maintenance & repair logs, expand Schedule maintenance or repair. Select Device, Service type, Due date and Assigned technician; add Visit notes and save.
When work starts, open the visit update, change SCHEDULED to IN_PROGRESS and select Save service update. A scheduled visit cannot be completed directly.

When work is finished, update the IN_PROGRESS visit to COMPLETED; enter repair/maintenance notes, parts and total service cost, then Save service update. Confirm history and, for a completed preventive-maintenance visit, the next maintenance date.
chapters.result: The delivered device retains warranty and service history, with the next planned maintenance date.
notes: Registration and scheduling are staff actions; a delivered serial does not create every maintenance visit automatically.
Completed/cancelled visits are immutable. Completing a preventive-maintenance visit advances the next maintenance date by the configured calendar-month interval; completing a repair does not.
Parts and costs here are service history. They do not automatically deduct spare-parts stock, create a customer service invoice or post a ledger expense.

connections.Comes from: POD-delivered serial and customer
connections.Next module: Maintenance visits, repair history and device-service report

screenshots.caption: Register verified delivered serials and review warranty/maintenance dates.
Schedule a visit and record its technician, notes, status and costs.

chapters.title: 46. Use financial overview, alerts, forecasts and 11 reports
chapters.roles: Authorized executive/report reader; available reports depend on role
chapters.purpose: Review operational exceptions and export management information from the same saved workflows.
before: Keep source shipments, receipts, delivery, finance and service records current.
steps: Open Executive Dashboard and review Operational alerts. Select an alert to open its available supporting report.

When your account also has Books read access, review Financial overview. Apply the inclusive From/Through Manila period and inspect posted revenue, expenses, profit/loss, cash/bank and ledger control cards plus the monthly trend. Current Finance subsidiary balances remain separately labelled.
Review Demand forecast. Read the history/sample limitations before using the forecast for replenishment planning.
In Management reports, choose the required report and inspect its generated date, columns and results.
Use Export CSV or Export Excel to share the selected report. Retain its generated date and any completeness notice with the exported analysis.
Reopen the source module to investigate a reported exception. Correct the real record there, then refresh the dashboard/report.
chapters.result: Management can follow alerts back to source data and export the reports permitted for the role.
notes: The 11 reports are Inventory valuation; Stock availability; Shipment performance; Landed cost approvals; Posted sales margin; Receivables aging; Payables aging; Customer balances; Supplier balances; Delivery fulfillment; Device warranty and service.
Forecasts use confirmed delivery history over 90 days to project 30 days. Insufficient history and incomplete samples are disclosed; a forecast is not a supplier order.

Financial cards need the relevant Books read access; permission to see operational reports alone does not expose the ledger. Use Books > Financial statements for complete detail and full filtered XLSX exports.
Posted sales margin is not net profit. Posted-ledger profit also reflects other posted expense accounts, and complete source postings and reviewed opening/closing balances remain necessary.

connections.Comes from: Saved inventory, shipment, delivery, posted finance and service data
connections.Next module: Operational follow-up, exports and role-scoped AI questions

screenshots.caption: Review the permitted financial overview, then continue down to operational alerts and forecasts.
Select a management report and export CSV or Excel.

chapters.title: 47. Ask the executive assistant and review invoice OCR
chapters.roles: Authorized AI user with underlying report permissions; OCR also needs AI Docs access
chapters.purpose: Ask questions about permitted company reports and extract invoice details for human review.
before: Confirm AI service configuration is available. Upload and index the intended invoice in AI Docs Engine before OCR.
steps: Open Executive AI & Invoice OCR. In Ask a question, enter a specific question, such as which products may need replenishment next month, and select Ask assistant.
Read the response and expand Sources. Compare any important figure with the named report before acting.
For OCR, select Load uploaded invoices & receipts. Choose the company-owned indexed document under Uploaded document.
Select Extract for review. Compare the supplier, dates, currency, quantities, unit prices, tax and totals against the original document.
Only after checking the source, tick I have reviewed the extracted information against the source.
Select Open Finance to enter verified bill when available. Enter the verified values in the bill form, then use the normal draft review and approval process.
chapters.result: The user receives a sourced answer or provisional extracted values without bypassing Finance approval.
notes: The assistant can use only the reports authorized for the requesting user and company. It does not execute arbitrary database changes.
OCR does not create or post a bill automatically. If AI or document indexing is unavailable, follow the displayed error and use verified manual entry.

connections.Comes from: Role-permitted reports and indexed company document
connections.Next module: Source-report review or manually entered verified Finance bill

screenshots.caption: Ask a specific company question and review the sources before acting.

chapters.title: 48. Start the separate payroll workflow
chapters.purpose: Prepare employee and attendance records before computing payroll; this workflow runs independently of sales Finance and Books.
before: Agree the company's shift, lunch-break treatment, cutoff periods and employee pay rules.
Restrict payroll access to staff who should see personnel and salary information.
steps: Open Payroll Engine from the company workspace and confirm the organization name.
On Dashboard Overview, review Total Employees, Total Net Processed and Shift Logs to understand the current saved records.
Review Current Default Shift. In the attendance configuration area, inspect Office In and Office Out before changing a company shift setting.
Follow the setup order: Register New employee, confirm the employee's Pay Profile, enter and Save Attendance, then Compute Payroll.
After saving payroll, use the saved payroll ledger for payslips, tax review and Summary Reports.
Use Gateway to return to the company workspace and Logout when finished.
chapters.result: Payroll staff follow a repeatable sequence based on saved employee rules and attendance.
notes: The employee's pay profile controls required paid days and overtime basis. Attendance date count alone does not define the payroll divisor.
Payroll figures and statutory deduction fields remain a separate workflow; they are not automatically posted into the new customer/supplier Finance ledgers.

connections.Comes from: Company payroll policy and authorized payroll access
connections.Next module: Employee registration and saved pay profile

screenshots.caption: The payroll dashboard starts a separate personnel-to-payroll workflow.

chapters.title: 49. Register and maintain employee records
chapters.module: Payroll Engine / Register New and Directory List
chapters.purpose: Create the employee identity, salary reference and deduction details before attendance/payroll entry.
before: Prepare the employee's verified personnel information and agreed salary details.
steps: Select Register New. Enter Employee ID, First Name, optional Middle Name and Last Name.
Complete Birth Date, Civil Status and Complete Address.
Enter Base Salary per Cutoff (₱), Employment Status and optional Bank Account No. Use the employee's agreed amount rather than copying another person's rate.
Enter any actual Cash Advance Balance, Advance Deduct/Cutoff, Company Loan Balance and Loan Deduct/Cutoff.
Complete available TIN, SSS Number, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG identifiers, then save the employee.
Open Directory List to locate the employee. Use Edit to maintain details and save the employee's separate Pay Profile before the first final payroll.
chapters.result: The employee can be selected in attendance and payroll for the same company.
notes: Employee identifiers, bank details and statutory numbers are sensitive personnel information; share only with authorized staff.
The salary field and the saved pay profile must describe the same agreed pay basis. A missing profile blocks final payroll saving until configured.

connections.Comes from: Verified employee/personnel and salary information
connections.Next module: One-time Pay Profile and saved attendance

screenshots.caption: Enter personnel, salary, loan and statutory details.
Locate the employee and maintain their saved record.

chapters.title: 50. Save each employee's agreed pay rules once
chapters.module: Payroll Engine / Compute Salary / Pay profile
chapters.purpose: Store the rule that automatically supplies rates, required paid days and overtime treatment in future cutoffs.
before: Register the employee and confirm their agreed pay basis, divisor and working-day schedule.
steps: Open Compute Payroll and select Compute Salary for the employee. Expand One-time pay profile setup required or Pay profile · saved rules.
Choose Overtime calculation. Excel cutoff balance (default) compares total cutoff hours with the required cutoff total. Daily overtime and separate shortfalls is an explicit alternative.
Choose Pay basis: Fixed cutoff salary or Fixed daily rate.
For fixed cutoff salary, enter Rate divisor in days. Required paid days use the same fixed divisor. For daily pay, enter Daily rate and choose working weekdays or a fixed number per cutoff.
When scheduled weekdays are used, tick the agreed working days. When fixed days are used, enter the agreed Paid days per cutoff.
Select Save Pay Profile. Wait for confirmation and Refresh Preview before reviewing payroll.
chapters.result: Future payroll cutoffs reuse the saved rules instead of requiring the same divisor to be entered repeatedly.
notes: Confirm the prefilled values against the employee agreement; a prefilled 14-day divisor is not proof that 14 is correct for every employee.
Excel cutoff balance uses 125% for hours above the required total and the normal hourly rate for a shortage. Calculations retain precision until currency amounts are rounded to cents.

connections.Comes from: Agreed employee salary and schedule
connections.Next module: Saved attendance and server-confirmed payroll calculation

screenshots.caption: Confirm pay basis, fixed divisor or weekdays, and overtime method before saving the profile.

chapters.title: 51. Enter the cutoff attendance and save once
chapters.purpose: Enter minute-precision work or leave records for the selected employee and cutoff.
before: Choose the correct employee, company, cutoff period and cutoff end month.
Prepare the actual time records; no seconds are required or supported in the entry fields.
steps: Select Log Attendance. Search and select Employee, then choose Cutoff period and Cutoff end month. For example, October with 26th–10th means September 26 through October 10.
Enter Time In and Time Out in h:mm AM/PM or HH:mm. Check AM/PM carefully; an earlier clock-out can indicate Ends next day.
Use Work, Paid leave or Unpaid leave as appropriate. Leave dates with no record blank; blank rows are not automatically leave.
Select + Add Session when another real session belongs on the same attendance date. Enter moves down the same time column; Tab moves between cells.
Review changed rows and select Save Attendance. Unsaved/Pending rows are not confirmed totals. Correct any row errors shown.
Use Check saved status / Refresh to confirm a save, or Reset Unsaved Changes to discard local edits. Inspect Total paid hours and Daily regular / Daily overtime totals after saving.
chapters.result: Saved attendance sessions become the authoritative input for payroll preview.
notes: Daily Regular/Overtime columns can differ from payroll's Excel cutoff-balance overtime because payroll applies the saved cutoff rule.

The configured lunch overlap is deducted from eligible work time; a short session outside the lunch period does not automatically lose one hour. Compare the same inputs and rules when reconciling Excel.

connections.Comes from: Verified clock-in/out and leave records
connections.Next module: Server-confirmed Compute Payroll preview

screenshots.caption: Select the cutoff, enter minute-level times and confirm Save Attendance.

chapters.title: 52. Review deductions and save payroll
chapters.purpose: Calculate the selected cutoff from saved attendance and the employee's saved pay profile.
before: Save the employee's pay profile and all attendance for the intended cutoff.
Prepare approved contribution, loan, cash-advance and other deduction amounts.
steps: Open Compute Payroll and choose Payroll cutoff and Cutoff end month. Select Compute Salary for the intended employee.
Wait for Server confirmed. Use Refresh Preview if attendance or profile changes were just saved. Review worked dates, leave counts and saved sessions.
Check Required Paid Days, Logged Hours, OT Hours, Rate per Day, Rate per Hour and Required Hours against the agreed profile.
Enter approved Govt Adj (±) and deductions such as Cash Advance, Company Loan, SSS, Pag-IBIG, PhilHealth and the applicable loan fields.
Use Declared Salary / Apply BIR Tax according to the employee's approved treatment. Review Gross Pay, withholding tax where applied, Total Deductions and Final Net Pay.
Select Close & Save. Confirm the saved payroll in the payroll ledger before printing or processing another record for the same cutoff.
chapters.result: The saved payroll retains its confirmed hours, earnings, deductions and net pay for reporting.
notes: A matching Excel result requires matching cutoff, time precision, breaks, rates/divisor, overtime basis, adjustments and deductions. Matching a total alone does not verify every source entry.
If a save is uncertain, inspect the saved payroll ledger before retrying. Do not create a second payroll simply because a response was delayed.

connections.Comes from: Saved profile, saved attendance and approved deductions
connections.Next module: Payslip, payroll exports, Tax Reports and Summary Reports

screenshots.caption: Review the server-confirmed calculation, deductions and final net pay before saving.

chapters.title: 53. Print payslips and export saved payrolls
chapters.purpose: Deliver the saved calculation to the employee and prepare reviewed payroll records for sharing.
before: Save payroll and confirm the employee and cutoff are correct.
steps: In Compute Payroll, locate the saved payroll record for the employee and intended cutoff.
Open its payslip/view action. Check employee name, required paid days, earnings, deductions and net earnings.
Select Print Slip and choose the intended printer or Save as PDF in the browser print dialog.
For a payroll data file, use Export All Payrolls. Review the exported dates and cutoff columns before sharing.
Use Export All as ZIP when a batch of saved payslip PDFs is required. Wait for PDF processing to finish before closing the page.

If a saved payroll needs correction, have the payroll administrator review the payroll, loan/cash-advance balances and any actual payment before an authorized correction. Do not delete and recreate simply to retry a save.
chapters.result: The employee copy and exported records reflect the saved payroll rather than an unsaved preview.
notes: Payslips and payroll exports contain salary and personal information. Share them only through the company's approved recipients and channels.
An export is a copy of recorded data. It does not execute the employee's bank payment.

connections.Comes from: Saved payroll ledger
connections.Next module: Employee payslip delivery, tax review and payroll summaries

screenshots.caption: Review the saved employee payslip, then select Print Slip.

chapters.title: 54. Review historical withholding tax reports
chapters.purpose: Find recorded withholding-tax results using a consistent date basis.
before: Save the payrolls to be reviewed and know whether the review concerns cutoff periods or payroll generation dates.
steps: Select Tax Reports and review the Tax Computation Report.
Choose Date Basis: Payroll Date (Generated) or Payroll Cutoff Period. These can return different records when payroll was saved after the cutoff.
Enter Date From and Date To, or choose Today, This Month or Last Month for an initial range.
Search Employee to narrow the results and select Apply Filter.
Review the listed employee, payroll/cutoff information, taxable figures and recorded withholding amounts. Use the report's available export action when a copy is required.
Use Clear Filter to clear dates while keeping the employee search, or Reset All to remove the full filter. Compare exceptions with the original saved payroll.
chapters.result: The report presents the saved withholding-tax records for the chosen employee/date basis.
notes: This is a report of the app's saved payroll calculations; it is not an automatic BIR filing or remittance.
The payroll/tax reviewer must confirm the employee treatment, source records and current company requirements before an external filing.

connections.Comes from: Saved payroll and declared-salary tax calculation
connections.Next module: Reviewed tax records and external filing/remittance process

screenshots.caption: Select the intended date basis, date range and employee before applying filters.

chapters.title: 55. Generate a payroll summary report
chapters.purpose: Summarize saved payroll records for an employee or selected reporting range.
before: Save the relevant payrolls and agree the reporting dates.
steps: Select Summary Reports.
Enter From Date and To Date. Choose Select Employee when reporting one employee, or the available all-employee option for a company summary.
Select the report-generation action and wait for the Payroll Summary Report preview.
Review employee names, number of payrolls, total days, total hours, overtime, gross pay, deductions and net pay.
Compare a sample employee with their saved payslips. Investigate duplicate or missing payroll records before sharing totals.
Select Print Report to print or save the reviewed summary as PDF through the browser dialog.
chapters.result: The summary gives a traceable total of the saved payroll records included by the selected filters.
notes: Payroll Summary Reports and the 11 ERP management reports serve different datasets. Payroll continues independently from sales/warehouse Finance.
A summary cannot correct a source payroll. Correct the approved underlying record, then regenerate the report.

connections.Comes from: Saved payroll records
connections.Next module: Management payroll review and approved employee payment process

screenshots.caption: Set the reporting range and employee, then review and print the summary.

glossary.meaning: The starting customer request, with customer, products, quantity and agreed prices. Customer fulfillment is derived from it.
The purchase order issued to a supplier. It buys stock and is distinct from the customer's sales/fulfillment obligation.
The final customer order document linked to the OS; an active FO is required for invoice creation from POD.
The packing document that supports fulfillment and delivery. It remains available alongside FO.
Goods receipt record showing received and QC-accepted, rejected or held quantities.
A lock on eligible stock for a customer order; it does not itself deduct physical stock.
First Expiry, First Out: picking eligible expiry-controlled stock in expiry order.
The confirmed issue of verified goods from physical stock for delivery.
Signed Proof of Delivery recording what the recipient actually received.
Supplier item cost plus allocated import expenses, converted to PHP using entered exchange rates.
Accounts receivable owed by customers / accounts payable owed to suppliers, based on posted Finance documents and allocations.
A draft awaits review. Posting creates the controlled accounting effect and retains the record in history.
An authorized financial adjustment against a posted invoice or bill; it does not itself move goods.

A named automatic Finance posting purpose, such as AR_CONTROL or BANK_CASH, mapped to an approved active ledger account. Reference mappings and manual journal account selections retain their separate meanings.
Posted revenue less posted expense accounts for the selected period. It is distinct from the sales-margin report and depends on complete, correctly posted sources.
Accumulated posted revenue less expenses presented within Balance Sheet equity; displaying it does not create an automatic fiscal-year closing entry.
An audited version assigning the exact signed cash-entry amount to operating, investing, financing or internal-transfer categories while preserving its original journal.
A comparison of current office and warehouse quantities at the existing cost reference with posted Inventory controls. Differences require investigation and do not create automatic adjustments.
The month in which the payroll cutoff ends. October with 26th–10th means September 26 through October 10.
The saved employee rule for pay basis, required paid days/divisor and overtime method.

checklists.title: First-time setup order
items: Create/select company and grant staff access.
Initialize standard accounts and add approved custom accounts.
Review optional POSTING_ROLE mappings and designate the actual cash/bank reporting accounts; retain standard defaults when no remapping is required.
Create customers/categories, products, suppliers/catalog links and facilities/bins.
Confirm product tracking controls and test QR labels.
Agree opening-balance treatment and employee pay profiles before live use.

checklists.title: Customer order - stock already on hand
items: Save OS and check prices/VAT.
Approve & reserve eligible stock.
Generate FO/PL and open linked delivery.
Verify FEFO picks, confirm dispatch and save signed POD.
Create invoice draft, review and approve/post.
Record actual receipt and allocate it; reconcile the bank entry.

checklists.title: Customer order - stock must be imported
items: Save OS demand and supplier PO using the source OS; do not duplicate a procurement route.
Create shipment, maintain customs clearance and collect import charges.
Save GRN/QC, place accepted goods into bins and reserve customer quantities.
Complete FO/PL, picking, dispatch and POD.
Approve landed-cost reference; create/post actual supplier bills separately.
Create/post customer invoice, allocate actual payments and reconcile bank statements.

checklists.title: Every payroll cutoff
items: Confirm company, employee and exact cutoff dates.
Save attendance and resolve Pending/unconfirmed records.
Confirm the saved pay profile and required paid days.
Review server-confirmed hours, adjustments and deduction amounts.
Save once and verify the payroll ledger.
Print payslip and review Tax/Summary Reports from the saved records.

checklists.title: Month-end operational and finance review
items: Investigate open shipments, QC hold/rejected goods and undelivered balances.
Review bin counts, expired stock and reservation exceptions.
Review draft invoices/bills, overdue balances and outstanding payment requests.
Match actual bank statements and complete reconciliations.
Apply the reviewed Manila period in Financial statements and retain complete report exports, including their Scope and totals.
Review cash-flow classifications and resolve unclassified movements or unmatched internal transfers, including zero-net exceptions.
Compare office/warehouse reference values with Inventory controls; investigate missing costs, timing and opening balances before an authorized correction.
Review service dates, document expiry reminders and role-permitted management reports.
Retain approved source documents, export dates and audit references.

troubleshooting.problem: A company or module is missing
troubleshooting.resolution: Ask the Super Admin to check company membership, module clearances, ERP role and any disabled module setting. Sign in again after access changes if needed.

troubleshooting.problem: Financial approval is denied
troubleshooting.resolution: Check the company's Finance approval limit and requested amount. Auditor remains read-only even with another role. Ask an authorized approver rather than splitting transactions to bypass a limit.

troubleshooting.problem: Delete account is disabled or blocked
troubleshooting.resolution: Only the global Super Admin can delete or restore ledger accounts. Unused standard or custom accounts are removed; accounts referenced by journals, mappings or reconciliations are archived with their history retained. Use Show archived accounts and Restore to make an archived account available for new transactions.

troubleshooting.problem: OS cannot reserve the requested quantity
troubleshooting.resolution: Inspect usable available stock, existing reservations, condition, batch/expiry and placement. Incoming shipment allocations are plans until stock is accepted and available.

troubleshooting.problem: Goods arrived but are not available for picking
troubleshooting.resolution: Check customs clearance, saved GRN quantities, QC acceptance and accepted-receipt bin placement. Quarantine/rejected goods are not available stock.

troubleshooting.problem: Dispatch cannot be confirmed
troubleshooting.resolution: Verify every pick quantity and inspect product, physical bin, batch and serial. Resolve missing reservation or eligibility before issuing stock.

troubleshooting.problem: Delivery is absent from invoice creation
troubleshooting.resolution: Confirm signed POD quantities and an active linked FO. A PL alone is insufficient. Check whether the same delivered quantities have already been invoiced.

troubleshooting.problem: A payment allocation is rejected
troubleshooting.resolution: Use posted documents for the same customer/supplier, keep each allocation within outstanding balance, and make the total equal the confirmed payment amount in PHP.

troubleshooting.problem: Bank reconciliation will not complete
troubleshooting.resolution: Match every statement line to the exact signed posted bank entry and verify opening/closing balances and dates. Investigate actual bank charges or missing postings before an approved correction.

troubleshooting.problem: A new accounting tab is missing
troubleshooting.resolution: New accounting screens require the matching app release. Ask the administrator to confirm the release and your module/ERP-role permissions. Inventory reconciliation requires both Books and Finance read access; financial dashboard cards need Books read access.

troubleshooting.problem: A posting-role mapping or new posting is rejected
troubleshooting.resolution: Check the selected company, active target account and required account type. Keep cash, Inventory, AR, input VAT, AP, output VAT and accrued controls distinct. Restore an archived target or ask Finance to approve a valid replacement; do not repeatedly change accounts to bypass the rejection.

troubleshooting.problem: A payment or memo requires historical source-account review
troubleshooting.resolution: The app must verify the original posted source accounts before clearing or adjusting them. Ask Finance to compare the source document and its journal. Do not make a substitute invoice, payment or manual correction just to bypass missing or inconsistent provenance.

troubleshooting.problem: Cash Flow remains incomplete even when its exception total is zero
troubleshooting.resolution: Review designated cash/bank accounts, every Unclassified entry and Unmatched transfer journals. Positive and negative exceptions can cancel without being correctly classified. Classify the actual entries and both sides of a same-journal internal transfer, then refresh the report.

troubleshooting.problem: Inventory reconciliation comparison is unavailable or differs from Books
troubleshooting.resolution: Review missing/invalid and zero cost references, negative balances, orphan references, receipt/bill timing, approved opening balances and the displayed Inventory controls. Unknown values are excluded from known totals and cannot be treated as zero. This report does not adjust stock or post a correction automatically.

troubleshooting.problem: A memo save response was lost
troubleshooting.resolution: While the same form remains open, retry the unchanged source, kind, amount and reason so its retained submission key can return the original saved memo. If the form was closed/reloaded or details changed, inspect the document list first. A new intentional memo is a separate submission.

troubleshooting.problem: A financial export contains more rows than the screen page
troubleshooting.resolution: Export complete report intentionally includes the complete filtered financial result, not just the current General Ledger page. Check its date/company basis and Scope and totals sheet; keep any Transfer exceptions sheet with a Cash Flow review.

troubleshooting.problem: AI Docs or OCR is unavailable
troubleshooting.resolution: Check the displayed connection/provider error with the administrator. Upload/index the document in the correct company and confirm AI Docs/OCR permissions. Use verified manual entry while processing is unavailable.

troubleshooting.problem: Attendance and payroll show different overtime
troubleshooting.resolution: Attendance shows daily regular/overtime; payroll may use Excel cutoff balance. Compare total paid hours, selected cutoff and saved employee overtime basis before assuming a discrepancy.

troubleshooting.problem: Payroll differs from Excel
troubleshooting.resolution: Compare the same minute-level times, cutoff dates, lunch/shift settings, pay basis, divisor/paid days, overtime method, adjustments and deductions. Do not compare one month or input set with another.

troubleshooting.problem: Save result is uncertain or network failed
troubleshooting.resolution: Restore the connection, refresh/check saved status and inspect the relevant ledger before saving again. A delayed response does not prove that the first save failed.
